decisions.reason: The resin injection unit fits the firm's plural-component and injection core, and no reported shortfall against aspiration would trigger problemistic search, though missing observations for 2020–2021 add some uncertainty.
Its overlap with Product A makes it the more likely injection unit to be consolidated, but without evidence of underperformance the firm's slack lets it carry both.
Automatic airless guns are integral to the firm's pump systems and sales, so they likely meet aspirations as part of the established line.
Manual airless guns are a steady-demand staple and accessory item with no sign of a performance gap.
The multi-model air-assisted line serves established industrial finishing customers, and individual models may be revised, but the line itself is unlikely to be withdrawn.

The data logger's results remain the most uncertain, but it supports the firm's digital and innovation direction, and slack allows it more time to prove itself rather than prompting search for other uses of its resources.
